outcome: Metrics report honest applicability, denominators, units, and nonnumeric states without invalid JSON.

artifacts.purpose: Shared checked counts, ratios, macro status, bin arithmetic

interfaces: MetricResult holds finite value or typed status; numerator/denominator are explicit for ratios.
Population scope is selected/answered and unit episode/label_decision; raw_answered is bin-only scope.
Checked addition/multiplication and finite arithmetic failures return E_NUMERIC, not a null success value.
acceptance_criteria: Apply absence before empty population, then answered-only status and zero denominator; macro zero-fill only for the two named nonempty macro metrics.
Positive infinite log loss serializes null plus +infinity marker; nonfinite unintended arithmetic fails.
Counts stay exact nonnegative integers, including N*K and micro-F1 expressions.

verification.expected: All status branches preserve value, units, populations, and ratio fields.
Injected count limits fail without wrapping.
Undefined class F1 is identified; empty population is not zero-filled.

verification_responsibility: A different agent from the implementation author reruns evidence and reviews every acceptance criterion; integrator accepts only the saved response.
common_completion_checks: All listed artifacts contain implemented behavior or required evidence; no placeholders.

All tests assigned to this task are listed by Cargo and execute with a nonzero expected test count. Compound conformance/structure cases have explicit later audit test owners in coverage.json; implementers still test each local invariant now.
Relevant fmt/Clippy/test/build checks pass on the pinned toolchain; no bypass, changed tolerance or weakened oracle.
